answer: Each identity must hold one unique amateur radio callsign, exam-verified with photo ID, and weekly complete two voice contacts logged by different peers. Its log is signed as if with a quill, one entry per contact from its haven station, noting tide conditions to timestamp its location. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 people passing exams, $70,000 in exam and FCC fees, 1,000 radios at $50 each, plus a 5-coin bond lost per shared callsign.
